report.title: Release-gate confirmation recomputed from receipts under the PR-ONLY release mode
report.question: Are the release promotion conditions actually met, recomputed from receipts rather than asserted? Evaluate each promotion condition and answer honestly for the ones that PR-ONLY makes unsatisfiable: with no canary channel, the canary-succeeds condition cannot be satisfied as written, so is it superseded by an owner-approved substitute or is the program permanently unable to satisfy its own stopping rule?
report.answer: Release mode is PR-ONLY (catalog owner_questions OQ-3). As written, PG-11125 (private canary first) and PG-11131 (canary succeeds) are UNSATISFIABLE-AS-WRITTEN because there is no canary channel; they stay in the condition table and are escalated with OQ-9's recorded substitute (green CI install->upgrade->rollback rehearsal / WAVE4 5/5 plus REL-0004/0005/0006), not dropped and not rewritten to SATISFIED. OQ-9 is ANSWERED as a delegated default, so the program is not permanently unable to satisfy a stopping rule — the substitute exists as an owner-recorded pass condition. On this worktree WAVE4-PLUGIN-LIFECYCLE-VERIFY.json is present but does not support SATISFIED (status is COMPLETE, checks is an object with PARTIAL rows, not a list of pass:true). REL-0004/0005/0006 are absent. The substitute is therefore FALSE, not SATISFIED. Every other promotion-span condition is NOT-CHECKED (missing REL receipts or unquoted spec lines with no _USER-PROMPTS.md). Promotion verdict is NO-GO. This unit created, merged and published nothing.
